groups.defect: Metrics are recorded with the wrong helper or label. Create (line 45) and Update (line 129) call recordLegacyDuration when storage fails. DeleteCollection's legacy goroutine (line 166) calls recordStorageDuration. Delete's success path (line 106) passes name where it should pass options.Kind. Delete also builds its context from d.Log rather than the enriched log (line 97).
groups.rationale: s_4c68a502 reports the swapped metric helpers in Create, Update and DeleteCollection, and also the Delete name/kind label. s_0d3070ec reports the Delete label together with the discarded enriched logger. These overlaps link every member into one chain of metric and logging copy-paste mistakes.

groups.defect: The Mode3 methods read options.Kind and listOptions.ResourceVersion without a nil check, so nil options cause a panic.
groups.rationale: All three report the same missing nil guard on options across the Mode3 methods, and they propose the same fix.

groups.defect: The async legacy goroutines derive their context from the request ctx, so the legacy write is cancelled as soon as the handler returns. s_a6079adb also reports a data race on the shared object pointer.
groups.rationale: All three report the same request-context cancellation problem in the async legacy writes. s_a6079adb also reports a data race, and the merged comment must keep it.

groups.defect: The Mode3 tests (Create, Delete, DeleteCollection, Update) never wait for or check the async legacy goroutine call.
groups.rationale: Each test function makes the same mistake of not synchronizing with the fire-and-forget legacy call. One testing approach, such as a WaitGroup or channel plus AssertExpectations, fixes all of them.
